messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
我目前沒有即時連接到 ATP 或 WTA 官方排名系統，無法告訴你「現在」哪位選手正位居世界第一。若你想知道最新排名，建議直接查閱：

- **ATP（男子）**：前往 [ATP 官方網站](https://www.atptour.com) 的「Rankings」頁面，或使用官方 App。
- **WTA（女子）**：前往 [WTA 官方網站](https://www.wtatennis.com) 的「Rankings」頁面，或使用官方 App。

這兩個網站都會即時更新每週的排名變動，並提供詳細的歷史排名、獎金、比賽成績等資訊。若你需要更進一步的分析（例如某位選手在過去一年中的排名走勢），也可以在這些平台上找到圖表和統計數據。

That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual player ranking. So we cannot use function. We can answer based on knowledge. But we need to check if we have up-to-date knowledge. As of 2026, we might not know. But we can approximate: In 2023, men's top was Novak Djokovic, women's top was Iga Swiatek. But as of 2026, unknown. We can say "I don't have real-time data." But we can provide general info. The user asked "currently". We can respond: "I don't have real-time data, but you can check ATP/WTA rankings." Provide explanation.
